page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hpc8ae.32xlarge is an x86_64 high-performance computing instance based on the KVM hypervisor. The machine is driven by dedicated AMD EPYC 9T34 processors operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. It is provisioned with 64 dedicated virtual cores and 256 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM balance with 4.0 GB of memory per core.

Network capacity is a prominent attribute of the architecture, offering a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth suitable for node-to-node communication in distributed environments. The hardware profile does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring persistence to be managed via external storage volumes. Additionally, the instance has zero discrete GPUs and does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high clock-rate dedicated AMD EPYC compute cores and elevated network throughput, ecs.hpc8ae.32xlarge is intended for computationally dense applications. Appropriate workloads include scientific modeling, engineering simulations, distributed batch computation, and large-scale software compilation where sustained per-core CPU performance and network capacity take precedence over local disk I/O.

Built on the KVM hypervisor, this instance delivers a 64 Gbps baseline network throughput profile tailored for intensive distributed computing. Without local disks or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, the configuration focuses strictly on dedicated CPU compute density and high-throughput networking. As a result, ecs.hpc8ae.32xlarge is structured for parallel computational workloads, engineering simulations, scientific analysis, large compilation jobs, and distributed batch processing pipelines where dedicated processing power and inter-node network throughput are critical.
